segments.source: Try Apollo black in your regular filter brewer before adding cream or using the bag mainly for large milk drinks. The purchase question is whether you welcome the citrus-and-floral direction, not whether you can force it to resemble a darker chocolate blend. Hologram is the more useful next comparison when you want fruit with a more familiar chocolate anchor.
